whenToUse: A public status page for an API or SaaS: components, uptime bars, incidents and maintenance.
Teams that publish incident updates and postmortems alongside history.
avoidWhen: Release notes and product updates — use site-changelog-01.
Help articles and support — use site-help-01.
a11y: Uptime bars support arrow-key navigation with day tooltips linked via aria-describedby.
The overall banner is a role="status" live region and motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
